text: Independent contractor (Brazil PJ) payment and expectations agreement. Not a CLT employment contract. PJ legal/tax wording should be finalized by the Company’s accountant or lawyer before signature.
Contractor provides Lead Media Buyer services as described in the attached Statement of Work, invoiced monthly in Brazilian reais (BRL).
Contractor is responsible for their own taxes, contributions, and PJ compliance.
Month 1 focuses on systems access, OS walkthrough, shadowing live accounts, and supervised onboard / funnel / headline reps. End of Month 1: founder check-in. No automatic raise.
Contractor starts Month 2 at L1 unless founder has already signed an unlock on the Level Checklist.
Levels unlock by skills demonstration only (founder sign-off on the checklist). New base starts the next full pay month after sign-off (no retroactive base unless founder writes an exception).

Pays the prior calendar month base (level then in force) + approved commissions.
Example: September work → approve early October → paid 9 October.
If the 9th is not a banking day, pay the next banking day (per accountant).
Contractor prepares the EOM sheet; founder approves; Contractor invoices; Company pays.

Company may adjust rates, floors, grace, or level criteria with 30 days’ written notice, typically at quarterly review. Structure changes should not conflict with work already completed in a closed pay month without written agreement.
EOM Sheet Template (operating tool; provided separately in company OS)
By signing, both parties agree to the terms in this Payment & Expectations Agreement and its listed attachments.
